title: Staff Engagement Survey
description:
Dear colleagues,

To maintain open dialogue and continue improving our working environment, we are launching a pulse survey.

Your feedback is the management team's primary guide: your responses will help us promptly support valuable initiatives, refine how work is organized, and make the Gymnasium an even better place for professional and personal growth.

The survey takes no more than 10 minutes to complete. We will carefully analyze the results across all areas—from mentoring and procedural transparency to workplace conditions and recognition.

Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and for the contribution you make every day. Together, we are creating a workplace where people want to work, grow, and reach new heights.

Please be sure to select the department where you work; providing your full name is optional.

Please rate each statement on a scale from 1 to 5, where: 1 — strongly disagree; 2 — somewhat disagree; 3 — difficult to answer; 4 — somewhat agree; 5 — strongly agree.
